name: plan-rm-atomic
body: `apg plan rm <project> --force` (cascade) must be atomic: the transient plan store is a single `apg/.trans/plans/<project>.jsonl`, so the cascade must be a whole-record JSONL rewrite — never a half-deleted plan. A failed or partial removal must leave the plan file exactly as it was. Acceptance: after a `--force` cascade the JSONL holds no orphan records (no task without its phase, no edge to a removed record); an error mid-cascade leaves the original file intact.
